notes: A new widget preset, Amber dusk: a gold-olive top that fades down to deep charcoal, warm off-white type and a sun-gold accent. It is the graded warm palette the phone’s own weather widget wears, and it sits with the bright presets, right above the dark ones.
It is a plain preset, so it behaves like the rest: pick it in Settings › Widget, it applies to every widget you have placed, and the fine-tune palette still works on top of it.
The Frost dial stays on Frosted glass and nowhere else — Amber dusk is opaque on purpose, so there is still exactly one glass preset to tune.
Nothing else moved — the other nineteen presets, the glass, the glass preview, the playing bars, the idle saver, the player, the library and the audio graph are exactly as they were.
